description: This file implements the FilePath class, providing methods for manipulating file path strings, including component extraction, extension handling, path normalization, and platform-specific path considerations.

classes.name: FilePath
classes.description: A class for representing and manipulating file system paths, with platform-specific handling and various utility methods for path components, extensions, and normalization.

methods.name: FindDriveLetter
methods.description: Finds the position of the drive letter in a path string on Windows.

methods.name: EqualDriveLetterCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Compares two paths case-insensitively, considering drive letters on Windows.

methods.name: IsPathAbsolute
methods.description: Determines if a given path is absolute based on platform-specific rules.

methods.name: AreAllSeparators
methods.description: Checks if a string consists solely of path separator characters.

methods.name: FinalExtensionSeparatorPosition
methods.description: Finds the position of the last extension separator in a filename.

methods.name: ExtensionSeparatorPosition
methods.description: Finds the position of the extension separator, considering double extensions.

methods.name: IsEmptyOrSpecialCase
methods.description: Checks if a path is empty, '.' or '..'.
